name: YouthCity Paid City Department Internship (Salt Lake City)
org: Salt Lake City Youth and Family Division
what_you_do: Teens work for 8 weeks in a Salt Lake City department. They go to workforce trainings, build a resume and plan a career path. Performance expectations match entry-level jobs.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 16 to 18 who are work eligible.
pay_detail: Paid. The wage is not stated on the program page.
duration: 8 weeks. No start or end dates are posted.
deadline_text: The program page gives no application dates. It lists no dates for summer 2027.
how_to_apply: The program page gives no steps to apply. Call Erica Andino at (385) 309-7439. She is the Senior Community Programs Manager.
notes: This is the paid internship. The two unpaid Child Development internships on the same page (grades 7 to 12) are a different program. The school-year afterschool program on the page said it was no longer taking applications.
